t: 在教皇博尼法斯八世于前几周去世后,选举本笃十一世为教皇.
te: Election of pope Benedict XI following the death of pope Boniface VIII in the previous weeks.
dz: 在教皇博尼法斯八世于前几周去世后,选举本笃十一世为教皇.
de: Election of pope Benedict XI following the death of pope Boniface VIII in the previous weeks.

te: Abbasid general Ahmad ibn Kayghalagh leads a raid against the Byzantine Empire, taking 4,000–5,000 captives.
dz: Abbasid将领Ahmad ibn Kayghalagh领导了对拜占庭帝国的突袭,俘虏了4000至5000人.
de: Abbasid general Ahmad ibn Kayghalagh leads a raid against the Byzantine Empire, taking 4,000–5,000 captives.

t: 日本天皇甘武将其帝国首都迁至平安京（现京都）。
te: Japanese Emperor Kanmu relocates his empire's capital to Heian-kyō (now Kyoto).
dz: 日本天皇甘武将其帝国首都迁至平安京（现京都）。
de: Japanese Emperor Kanmu relocates his empire's capital to Heian-kyō (now Kyoto).

dz: 关于耶稣的神性和人性,Chalcedonian Creed由普世理事会Chalcedon理事会通过.
de: The Chalcedonian Creed, regarding the divine and human nature of Jesus, is adopted by the Council of Chalcedon, an ecumenical council.

t: 中国上空发生日食,是人类历史上最早记载的日食之一,据报道导致两名天文学家被处决而未能预测.
te: A solar eclipse occurs over China, one of the earliest recorded in human history, reportedly resulting in the execution…
dz: 中国上空发生日食,是人类历史上最早记载的日食之一,据报道导致两名天文学家被处决而未能预测.
de: A solar eclipse occurs over China, one of the earliest recorded in human history, reportedly resulting in the executions of two astronomers who failed to predict it.
